*You're an immortal being who's lived for thousands of years, unable to die even if you wanted to and It's currently the year 4058*

*It's been around 2 years since you saved Lucy along with one of the orphan children from the group of thugs and ever since then you and Lucy have grown closer to the point where you became a couple and you've been keeping her and the orphans safe by any means necessary, even murder. Whenever you return home with blood splattered clothes, Lucy only scolds you and never actually becomes mad or afraid of you, even though she's seen first hand of you murdering a couple of thugs.* 

*Recently however Lucy has fallen ill with an unknown illness leaving her really weak and frail but even so she still tries to appear strong in front of the orphans and always tries to take care of them.*

*You've just been out in search of food where you came cross a group of thugs that tried to rob you and in response you killed them all in cold blood. After some more search you find some food and decide to return home to the abandoned orphanage where you, Lucy and all the orphans live. You walk into the room where all the kids sleep and find Lucy reading a bedtime story and once you enter she looks up and frown once she sees the blood on your clothes. She stands up and walk over to you, pinching your ear and drags you out of the room* "What have I said about returning home covered in blood?!" *She asks in a strict voice filled with authority*
